props.label: About the Clinic
props.heading: Evidence-based dental, skin and hair care
props.body:
Welcome to Aesthetic Dental & Skin Clinic, Nagpur. Led by Dr. Kanchan Lokhande, our clinic provides evidence-based dental, skin, hair and aesthetic treatments tailored to each patient's individual needs.

We combine clinical expertise, modern technology and personalised care to help patients achieve healthier smiles, healthier skin, stronger hair and enhanced confidence. Our approach focuses on accurate diagnosis, evidence-based treatment, patient education and long-term results.

From preventive dental care and smile designing to acne treatment, pigmentation correction, hair restoration and laser procedures, we focus on safe, ethical and result-oriented treatment in a comfortable clinical environment.

Every treatment plan is tailored to the individual's needs, concerns and treatment goals.

seo.title: Dental, Skin, Hair & Laser Treatments | Aesthetic Clinic, Nagpur
seo.description: Root canal, dental implants, crowns and bridges, smile designing, acne and pigmentation treatment, chemical peels, PRP hair therapy, trichoscopy and laser hair reduction in Nagpur.

props.label: Every Treatment
props.heading: What we treat
props.sub: Twenty treatments across dental, skin, hair and laser care. Every plan begins with an assessment, and the options are explained to you before anything starts.

items.title: Teeth Cleaning & Polishing
items.desc: Removal of plaque and hardened tartar above and below the gumline, followed by polishing. The routine treatment for bleeding gums and persistent bad breath.

items.title: Root Canal Treatment
items.desc: Treatment for an infected or badly decayed tooth — the nerve space is cleaned, disinfected and sealed, then the tooth is capped to protect it.

items.title: Tooth-Coloured Fillings
items.desc: Composite fillings matched to your natural tooth shade and bonded directly, so less healthy tooth is removed than with metal.

items.title: Crowns & Bridges
items.desc: Custom crowns to cap a weakened or root-treated tooth, and bridges to span a gap using the neighbouring teeth for support.

items.title: Dental Implants
items.desc: A titanium post placed in the jaw to replace a missing tooth root, later restored with a crown. Includes planning, placement and the healing review.

items.title: Smile Designing
items.desc: A planned combination of treatments to improve the appearance of your smile, assessed and designed around your facial proportions.

items.title: Acne Treatment
items.desc: Assessment of the cause of your acne followed by a treatment plan — topical, procedural or both — rather than a single generic protocol.

items.title: Pigmentation Treatment
items.desc: Treatment for melasma, sun damage and uneven tone, planned after a detailed skin assessment and matched to your skin type.

items.title: Chemical Peels
items.desc: Medical-grade peels selected by strength and type for your concern and skin type, to improve texture, tone and blemishes.

items.title: Anti-Aging Procedures
items.desc: Clinical procedures for fine lines, volume loss and skin laxity, discussed with realistic expectations before anything is carried out.

items.title: Medi Facials
items.desc: Clinically formulated facial treatments chosen for your skin assessment, rather than an off-the-shelf salon facial.

items.title: Acne Scar Management
items.desc: Treatment of post-acne scarring and marks using the approach suited to the scar type, which is what actually determines the result.

items.title: Hair Fall Evaluation
items.desc: Clinical evaluation to identify the underlying cause of hair loss before any treatment is recommended — the step most often skipped.

items.title: Trichoscopy
items.desc: Magnified examination of the scalp and hair shafts to assess follicle health and support an accurate diagnosis.

items.title: Hair Regrowth Consultation
items.desc: A customised treatment plan based on your evaluation, including PRP therapy and other hair restoration options where suitable.

items.title: Dandruff Management
items.desc: Assessment and treatment of scalp conditions causing flaking, itching and irritation, addressing the cause rather than masking it.

items.title: Laser Hair Reduction
items.desc: Laser hair reduction with settings selected according to your skin type and hair characteristics, over a planned course of sessions.

items.title: Laser Toning
items.desc: Laser treatment to improve overall skin tone and clarity, planned according to your concern and desired outcome.

items.title: Pigmentation Laser Treatment
items.desc: Targeted laser treatment for pigmentation, chosen after assessment of the type and depth of the pigment.

items.title: Skin Rejuvenation
items.desc: Procedures to improve overall skin quality, texture and radiance, selected according to skin type and clinical goals.

items.a: Monday to Saturday we see patients between 11 AM and 8 PM, and booking ahead means you are seen at your slot. Sunday is by prior appointment only. Call or WhatsApp 82376 67762 to arrange a time.

items.q: How do I know which treatment I need?
items.a: You do not need to decide beforehand. Every plan starts with an assessment — a dental examination, a skin assessment or a hair and scalp evaluation — and the treatment options are explained to you after that, with the reasoning.

Cost depends entirely on what the assessment finds and which plan you choose, so we give you the figure after examining rather than a number that changes later. For longer courses you get the full plan and cost before anything begins.

items.q: How many sessions will I need?
items.a: A filling or a cleaning is usually one visit. A root canal is one or two. Skin and laser treatments generally run as a course of sessions, and the expected number is given at your assessment rather than open-ended.

No, and be cautious of any clinic that promises otherwise. Individual results vary with the condition being treated, the treatment plan and how closely aftercare is followed. We will tell you honestly what is realistic for your case.

items.q: Is the clinic safe and sterile?
items.a: We follow strict sterilisation and safety protocols across dental, skin, hair and laser treatment. If you would like to see how instruments are processed, ask — we are happy to show you.
We see patients from Sakkardara, Azamshah Layout, Nandanvan, Manewada, Besa, Chitnis Park, Mahal and nearby areas of Nagpur. The clinic is at Gajanan Square on Juni Shukrawari Road.
